visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a crowded indoor station escalator with many commuters. In the foreground, two women with medium-length hair are seen from behind; one wears a black coat and a crossbody bag, the other wears a cream-colored sweater and jeans. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A close-up shot shows thin slices of beef tongue and marbled beef being grilled on a metal mesh over a hot charcoal fire. One slice is being flipped with metal tongs. (3) A tray of chocolate éclairs is displayed; each éclair has a dark chocolate base and three round chocolate cream puffs on top. A price tag is visible in front of them. (4) The camera shows the interior of 'PUBLIC TOKYO,' a brightly lit clothing store with modern decor, featuring mannequins dressed in trench coats and jackets. (5) Several small gift boxes with illustrations of a Shiba Inu and a cat are displayed on a wooden shelf next to a floral 'Happy Gift' card. (6) A mobile screen recording begins, showing a Google Maps interface centered on Harajuku, Tokyo. The user interacts with the map, which is filled with standard blue location icons. (7) The user selects a specific restaurant, 'Tsujita Ginza,' and taps on the 'Save' button. A menu pops up showing various existing lists like 'Coffee' and 'Bread.' (8) The user chooses to create a 'New List,' and the screen displays an icon selection page with various food and object emojis. (9) The user selects a ramen emoji and names the list 'Noodle Type' in Chinese. The interface shows the process of saving the location with the custom icon. (10) The map is shown again, but now several locations feature specific food icons (ramen, pizza, coffee) instead of generic pins. (11) The final scene shows two dogs, a husky and a Shiba Inu, sitting in a double pet stroller decorated with pink floral leis. People's hands reach out to pet them under blooming cherry blossom trees in an outdoor setting.

(5) [Subtitle]: 後來發現可以改圖示, 這樣子就很清楚想找的類型. (6) [Slogan]: 新增方式簡單, 找一家想標註的店. [Variety]: 按「儲存」新增清單. (7) [Variety]: 選擇想用的圖. (8) [Variety]: 加上命名就好囉. (9) [Subtitle]: 在地圖上顯示出來了. (10) [Subtitle]: 還沒用過的也試試看吧.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions through a busy station interior, a high-end yakiniku restaurant grill, a dessert shop display, a modern clothing boutique, a mobile phone screen interface, and an outdoor park area with cherry blossoms and traditional lanterns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, medium-tempo acoustic BGM featuring bright piano and guitar strumming starts immediately. It maintains a consistent, happy Major-key vibe throughout. A faint ambient station murmur is heard underneath. (2) As the visuals show meat on a grill, a sharp sizzling SFX is layered over the music, mimicking the sound of cooking. (3) The BGM continues smoothly without interruption. (4) A short, bright digital 'ping' SFX accompanies the screen transition. (5) During the screen recording of the map, multiple soft UI 'taps' and 'click' sound effects are synchronized with the user's interaction with the smartphone interface. (6) A distinct 'ding' sound effect triggers when the custom list is successfully created and the emoji is selected. (7) The BGM continues as the primary audio layer through the final shot of the dogs, concluding with the bright acoustic melody.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a practical travel tip tutorial for tourists visiting Japan. It highlights the abundance of food and shopping attractions before addressing a common pain point: the visual clutter of standard map pins. It then provides a clear, step-by-step guide on how to customize Google Maps icons with emojis to improve trip planning efficiency.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality social media editing with a clear information flow. Uses emojis and UI dings to maintain engagement during the technical tutorial section.
